script:
EXT. KAHALU'U BAY - DAY

A hot, humid daylight surf window holds over Kahalu'u Bay, Kona Coast, Big Island.
Hot, humid Kona Coast surf conditions with summer swell timing, lava rock reef constraints, glare, saltwater, softened wax, fatigue, and local lineup etiquette. heat, humidity, glare, saltwater, fatigue, lava rock reef, summer swell, local surf etiquette
Embry's navy rashguard has gone dark at the collar and ribs. Sweat beads on her upper lip, salt dries white at her temples, and the heat makes the borrowed white shortboard's wax feel soft under her palms.

ACTION
Embry’s phone buzzes on the beach bag like obligation had learned echolocation.
A silver lump gathers outside the lineup. Embry checks the dark lava shapes under the clear water, resets her rail grip when her right palm skids, and forces herself to breathe before the board yaws across the swell.
Kai, black rashguard shining with spray, waits farther out on his familiar white board. He watches the locals, the channel, and Embry's paddle cadence, then holds position instead of taking the easy wave.

DIALOGUE
EMBRY
This heat is trying to surf the board before I do.

KAI
If we paddle now, we're cutting across the lineup.

EMBRY
Then we wait until it is ours.

ACTION
Her phone buzzes from the beach bag and stops. Embry wipes sweat from her mouth with the back of her wrist, lets the first peak pass to the local already angled in, and turns only when the next clean shoulder stands up over the reef. Kai gives one small nod toward the safe channel. Embry commits with tired arms, not because the day is harmless, but because this choice is finally hers.

source_context_summary.core_idea: Embry and Kai both faked a sick day at their summer jobs to go surfing on the Big Island on a Wednesday in June of 2024 — Kona Coast, Kahaluʻu Bay, summer swell patterns, lava rock reefs, local surf etiquette.

environment.description: Hot, humid Kona Coast surf conditions with summer swell timing, lava rock reef constraints, glare, saltwater, softened wax, fatigue, and local lineup etiquette.

source_context_summary.story_excerpt: Embry’s phone buzzes on the beach bag like obligation had learned echolocation. Ten yards out, a clean June lump lifts over the dark lava reef; glare turns the face silver, and her older white shortboard’s softened wax lets one palm skid. Kai, outside on his familiar board, doesn’t call her in. He waits, trims aside for a local, then points two fingers at the safe channel. Embry resets her rail grip, saves three tired strokes, and chooses the wave.
